notes: Sky page: phone alerts when a VIP flight (Air Force One/Two, Marine One, SAM flights out of Andrews) comes within 15 miles, and for any aircraft emergency in range - switch them on or off on the new Logbook & stats tab. That tab also keeps a logbook of every VIP, military and government plane heard (tap one to see its path on the map), today's sky stats (planes seen, farthest, highest, fastest, busiest hour) and a coverage chart of how far the roof antenna hears in each direction (also as a map overlay). Tapping a plane now shows where it is flying from and to, and a photo of the actual aircraft. Airports and airstrips around the house are marked on the map, and the ones on a tapped flight's route light up. The kitchen wall shows a short note when a plane passes right over the house, and the morning brief mentions any VIP or military flyover.
